method: Inline reuse, quality and efficiency passes with exact ce-simplify-code persona rubrics; available agents occupied by finalized evidence/real desktop checks

efficiency.reason: Configuration/probe work is once per short-lived client construction, not the resident listener or request hot hook. Hook is nonthrowing and allocation-free at C++ level; transient owner cleanup is retained.
